game.province_garrison.definition:
select
      g.world_id,
      g.province_id,
      g.unit_type,
      sum(g.count)::bigint as count
    from (
      select
        a.world_id,
        a.location_province_id as province_id,
        au.unit_type,
        au.count
      from game.armies a
      join game.army_units au
        on au.world_id = a.world_id
       and au.army_id = a.army_id
      where a.state = 'garrison'

      union all

      select
        ng.world_id,
        ng.province_id,
        ng.unit_type,
        ng.count
      from game.neutral_garrisons ng
    ) g
    group by g.world_id, g.province_id, g.unit_type
game.province_garrison.name: province_garrison
